description: Defines an abstract class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Collection that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value, representing a collection type (array or struct) for XML-RPC values with methods to set and get the collection's value.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Collection
classes.description: An abstract class for XML-RPC collection types (arrays and structs), providing constructor logic to initialize values and a method to retrieve the PHP array representation of the collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with an array of values, converting non-Zend_XmlRpc_Value objects as needed.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the collection's values as a PHP array, converting each Zend_XmlRpc_Value to its native PHP representation.
